description: This file provides a WebSocket wrapper for real-time features, including functions to create a WebSocket connection and connect to a notification WebSocket endpoint. It is primarily used for establishing real-time communication channels in a frontend application.

methods.name: createWebSocket(endpoint, onMessage, onError)
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket client connection for live features, accepting an endpoint URL, message callback, and optional error callback.

methods.name: connectNotificationWebSocket({ onMessage, onError })
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for notifications, dynamically constructing the URL based on environment variables or default values.
